create_huggingface_repo: create a huggingface repository with a model card for pushing an unsloth finetuned model
merge_and_dequantize_lora: merge lora adapters into a dequantized 16 bit model and optionally push to huggingface hub
merge_and_overwrite_lora: download base model safetensors shards and merge lora weights directly into them in place
find_skipped_quantized_modules: find which modules were skipped during bitsandbytes 4 bit quantization in a pytorch model
check_model_quantization_status: check if a local or huggingface model is quantized and return its quantization type
